February 28, 1933. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS.

residents of the district have detailed representatives
to the Municipality to request that the collection be
postponed.
At 10 a.m. yesterday, the residents detailed
Representatives to submit an appeal to the Municipality
that the house rents in the districts be further reduced
and exempted.

Shun Pao:

2 DEATH PENALTY PASSED ON ASSASSINS OF ADMIRAL WU.

The four assassins of the late Admiral Wu
Lweng Chung of the Chinese Navy were sentenced to death
by the Nantao District Court at 3 p.m. yesterday.

The Crystal, a mosquito paper:-

THE NEWSPAPER CENSORSHIP.

It is reported that commencing from March 1,
the newspaper censorship will be jointly undertaken by
Tao Fah Chuan, delegate of the local Tangpu Headquarters,
Chen Ko Zung (陳克誠) of the Municipality of Greater
Shanghai and Staff Officer Yang (楊 ) of the
Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner's Headquarters.

China Times:

BENEVOLENCE VARIETY ENTERTAINMENT AT KIANGWAN.

Prominent philanthropists in Shanghai will
hold a Benevolence Variety Entertainment at Yih Yuan
Garden, Kiangwan for one month commencing from March 11.
The entrance fee will be $1, 40% of the proceeds will
be given to the owner of the garden; 20% will be contributed
to the Chinese Kidnapping Society, and the remaining
40% will be used for relief work in the war devastated
areas, as well as for the development of aviation and
for the support of volunteers of North China.

1933年2月28日。下午译件。

杂项。

该区居民已派出代表向市政府请求延期征收。
昨日上午10时，居民派出代表向市政府提交请愿书，要求进一步减免该地区的房屋租金。

《申报》：

判处刺杀吴海军上将的凶手死刑。

中国海军已故吴光宗（Wu Lweng Chung）海军上将的四名刺客于昨日下午3时被南市地方法院判处死刑。

《晶报》，一份小报：

新闻审查。

据悉，自3月1日起，新闻审查工作将由当地汤浦总部代表陶法川（Tao Fah Chuan，音译）、大上海市政府陈克诚以及吴淞-上海卫戍司令部参谋杨军官（Staff Officer Yang，音译）共同负责。

《时事新报》：

江湾慈善游艺会。

上海知名慈善家将于3月11日起在江湾怡园举行为期一个月的慈善游艺会。入场费为1元，收入的40%归园主所有；20%捐给中国防绑会，其余40%用于战区救济工作，以及发展航空事业和支持华北义勇军。

pages.en:
Opium Said
Cause Of Wu
Assassination

Drug Dealers, Admiral
Are Alleged To Have
Quarreled Over Shares
Of Narcotic Profits

Official Shot Down By
4 Gunmen In Home;
Survived By 3 Wives

Opium, which has been reported to be on public sale in Kiangsu, was alleged to be the cause of the assassination of Rear Admiral Wu Kwang-sung, veteran Chinese naval officer and chief of the hydrographic department of the Chinese navy, yesterday morning. Funeral services for the aged admiral will be held at the Chapel of the International Funeral Directors, Kiaochow Road, at 5 p.m. today.

While the cause of the death of Admiral Wu could not be ascertained from his family, it was alleged by several reliable Chinese sources last night that a serious dispute arising from division of proceeds of opium between the deceased and provincial opium traders, brought an end to his life. Well-informed circles stated that the assassination had political connection.

It was said that the admiral, by virtue of his position, could have easily taken the responsibility for the transportation of the drug but the "commission" was too small to satisfy him. This dissatisfaction drew fire from opium traders and their assistants who were seeking an outlet of the drug to outports, it was stated.

The first news of public sale of opium in Kiangsu was received by the National Anti-Opium Conference held last month here. The conference wired to General Tso Tsu-tung, chairman of the Kiangsu Provincial Government, voicing strong opposition. The wire brought no reply.

Police Promise Justice

The murder caused a sensation among Chinese official circles yesterday especially in the Ministry of Navy. The ministry was told of the cold-blooded affair last night by Captain Chen Liang, commander of the First Squadron of the Chinese navy. Mr King Tien, head of second division of the Ministry, in whose jurisdiction the daring crime was committed, promised to bring the assassins to justice within three days.

Rear Admiral Wu was shot in four places about his body at about 1 o'clock in the morning. He was rushed to the Lester Chinese Hospital where he died at 1:25. An inquest over his body will be held today before the funeral takes place.

Four gunmen, armed with Mauser automatic pistols, entered the admiral's residence from the back door. Locking up the body-guard and servants they pulled the admiral from his bedroom and fatally shot him on the staircase. Major-General Wen Hung-en, commissioner of the Bureau of Public Safety, immediately proceeded to the scene of the tragedy after the alarm was raised. He is personally conducting an investigation. Orders for arrests of the assassins were issued but no arrest had been made last night.

Was Second Attempt On Life

The shooting was the second in which the admiral was involved. Five years ago an attempt was made on his life. His front teeth were shattered and lower jaw injured on that occasion.

The deceased is survived by three wives, two in Amoy, his native province, and three sons. One of the sons is a cadet at the Naval Academy in Momo, Fukien, while the other two are in Shanghai. Rear Admiral Wu was one of the first Chinese naval officers trained to command modern warships. He has commanded many ships and had relinquished command to become a councillor to the Navy. He was planning to retire from active service yesterday afternoon.

据称鸦片
是吴被刺
的原因

据称毒贩与海军上将
因毒品利润分成
发生争执

官员在家中遭
4名枪手枪击；
遗孀三人

据报道在江苏公开出售的鸦片，据称是导致中国资深海军军官、中国海军海道测量局局长吴光松（Wu Kwang-sung，音译）海军少将于昨晨被刺的原因。这位年迈的海军上将的葬礼将于今天下午5时在胶州路万国殡仪馆礼堂举行。

虽然从吴上将家属处无法确定其死因，但昨晚几位可靠的中方消息人士称，死者与省级鸦片商人之间因鸦片收益分配引发的严重争端，导致了他生命的终结。知情人士表示，此次刺杀具有政治背景。

据说，上将凭借其职位，本可轻易承担毒品运输的责任，但“佣金”太少，无法满足他的要求。据说，这种不满引来了寻求将毒品销往外埠的鸦片商人及其助手的杀机。

上月在此举行的全国禁烟会议首次获悉江苏公开出售鸦片的消息。会议致电江苏省政府主席曹祖同（Tso Tsu-tung，音译）将军，表示强烈反对。该电报未获回复。

警方承诺伸张正义

谋杀案昨日在中国官场，尤其是海军部引起了轰动。中国海军第一舰队司令陈良（Chen Liang，音译）上尉昨晚向海军部通报了这起冷血事件。该大胆犯罪案件管辖范围内的海军部第二司司长金天（King Tien，音译）先生承诺在三天内将刺客绳之以法。

吴海军少将在凌晨1点左右身中四枪。他被紧急送往莱斯特的华人医院，于1点25分死亡。葬礼前，今天将对他的尸体进行验尸。

四名手持毛瑟自动手枪的枪手从后门进入上将寓所。他们锁住保镖和仆人，将上将从卧室拖出，并在楼梯上将其致命射杀。警报响起后，市公安局局长文鸿恩少将立即赶赴悲剧现场。他亲自主持调查。虽已发出逮捕刺客的命令，但昨晚尚未有人被捕。

这是第二次未遂刺杀

这次枪击是将将涉及的第二次遇袭。五年前曾有人试图刺杀他。在那次事件中，他的门牙碎裂，下颚受伤。

死者遗有三位妻子，两位在其故乡省份厦门，另有三个儿子。其中一个儿子是福建马尾（Momo，音译）海军学院的学员，另外两个在上海。吴海军少将是首批接受指挥现代战舰训练的中国海军军官之一。他曾指挥多艘舰船，后卸任指挥职务成为海军顾问。他原计划于昨日下午退役。

Subject (in full) Murder of Admiral Wu Kwang Chung 吴志荣

Made by Supt. Tan Shao-liang Forwarded by Tho Robertson, Supt

I have known the deceased for the past ten
years. He commenced his career as Captain of a
gunboat attached to the 1st squadron of the Chinese
Navy. Between 1924 and 1928 he was Chief of Staff
to the Ministry of Marine. During this period he
figured in several cases of smuggling large quantities
of Persian opium to Shanghai and according to rumours
then in circulation, he quarrelled with some of his
colleagues over the division of the "protection money"
for the consignments. About three years ago whilst
driving in a motor car outside the West Gate in Chinese
territory not far from his house, he was attacked by
several desperadoes who fired a shot at him. The
bullet hit him on the neck but he was not killed.
The assailants escaped and have not been arrested.

I was then informed by a naval official (Captain
Chiang if I remember right) that the attempt on his
life was possibly the outcome of spite over opium
deals. Although he was 60 years of age, the deceased
frequented dancing and amusement resorts and had a
weakness for women. He had four concubines living
at separate places. One of these living in the City
absconded some time ago with property and Admiral Wu
threatened that if she was caught, she would be dealt
with severely. This was about a year ago.

The deceased was in 1930 appointed Director
of the Naval Hydrographic Bureau, off Route Ghisi,
which post he held until his death. He had a big
staff including a foreigner and four gunboats at his

制作人 谭绍良督察 转呈者 罗伯逊督察

我认识死者已有十年。他职业生涯始于中国海军第一舰队所属炮艇艇长。1924年至1928年间，他担任海军部参谋长。在此期间，他卷入数起向上海走私大量波斯鸦片的案件，据当时流传的谣言，他因这批货物的“保护费”分配问题与一些同事发生争执。大约三年前，当他在中国领土西门外离家不远的地方驾车时，遭到几名歹徒袭击，向他开了一枪。子弹击中他的颈部，但他并未身亡。袭击者逃脱，至今未被逮捕。

当时一位海军官员（如果我没记错的话是蒋船长）告诉我，这次未遂刺杀可能是鸦片交易结怨的结果。虽然死者已60岁，但他常出入舞厅和娱乐场所，且好女色。他有四位姨太太分居各处。其中一位住在市区，不久前携财产潜逃，吴上将威胁说如果抓到她，将严惩不贷。这大约是一年前的事。

死者于1930年被任命为吉司路（Route Ghisi，音译）附近的海军海道测量局局长，直至去世一直担任该职。他手下职员众多，包括一名外国人和四艘炮艇供其

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Translation of Letter from Shanghai Public Safety Bureau.
No. 372. September 22, 1932.

S.M.P. Headquarters,
Shanghai.

Sirs,

Regarding the murder of Admiral Wu Kwang Chung, (吴光宗)
Director of the Hydrographic Department, at his residence,
No. 16 Ning Kaung Li (宁康里) off Fong Zia Road (方斜路),
on 21.9.32, a report submitted by our No. 2 District
states as follows :-

"At about 8.40 a.m. September 21, immediately after
the report made by Constable Zau Kwang Ching (赵广清) on
the above subject, Inspectors Van Tsong Liang (范宗良)
and Tseng Foo Teh (曾福德) and Detective Sergeant Du Zai
Sung (杜在松) at once proceeded to the scene and the
following facts were ascertained :-

Wu Tsang Sz (吴藏司), Concubine of the deceased, states,
'At about 8.25 a.m. 4 men, 2 armed with a 5' pistol
each and 2 armed with Mauser pistols, entered our house by
the back gate, where one of them remained guard, and the
three others produced pistols threatening our body-guard
Zi Tah Wah (纪达华) and other inmates and herding them
into a room downstairs, and then they rushed upstairs.
The deceased, whilst toileting, was pulled out to the
stairway where he was shot at receiving 4 wounds; one on
the right side of chest, one on the right side of neck, one
on the left lip and the other on the left thigh. The mur-
derers made good their escape. Description :- All spoke
Northern dialect. Two dressed in grey long gowns, one in
black long gown and another in short blue cotton clothing.'

Constable Zau Kwang Ching states,
'At about 8.30 a.m. I was on post duty on Fong Zia
Road. I observed 4 men passing me in a suspicious manner.
Before I could stop them, I heard an alarm from the
direction of Ning Kaung Li alleyway shouting 'catch robbers'.
I drew my pistol and went on to give chase. The murderers
fired 8 or 9 shots to deter pursuers. I returned fire
firing 5 shots. Finally I lost sight of these men on the
western side of the Tah An Li alleyway (泰安里).

Deceased :- Wu Kwang Chung, Director of the Hydrographic
Department, age 63 years, native of Ming Eu Hsien (闽侯县),
Fokien. Three years ago an attempt was made on his life,
on which occassion one of his teeth was knocked off.
He after having been wounded was immediately removed to
the Lester Hospital by his family.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER : SEPT 22 1932 (CRIME BRANCH)）
（批：9/22）

先生们：

关于海道测量局局长吴光宗（Wu Kwang Chung）于 1932 年 9 月 21 日在其位于方斜路（Fong Zia Road）宁康里（Ning Kaung Li）16 号的寓所被杀一案，我局第二区提交的报告陈述如下：-

“9 月 21 日上午 8 时 40 分左右，在警员赵广清（Zau Kwang Ching）就上述事项报告后，巡捕范宗良（Van Tsong Liang）、曾福德（Tseng Foo Teh）及侦探警长杜在松（Du Zai Sung）立即赶赴现场，查明以下事实：-

死者妾室吴藏司（Wu Tsang Sz）称，‘上午 8 时 25 分左右，4 名男子进入我家后门，其中 2 人各持一把 5 英寸手枪，另 2 人持毛瑟手枪。其中一人在门口把守，另外三人掏出手枪威胁我们的保镖纪达华（Zi Tah Wah）及其他住户，并将他们驱赶至楼下房间内，随后冲上楼。死者当时正在洗漱，被拖至楼梯口并遭枪击，身中四弹；一处位于右胸，一处位于右颈，一处位于左唇，另一处位于左大腿。凶手随即逃逸。特征描述：均讲北方方言。两人身着灰色长衫，一人身着黑色长衫，另一人身着蓝色短棉衣。’

警员赵广清（Zau Kwang Ching）称，
‘上午 8 时 30 分左右，我正在方斜路执勤。我观察到 4 名男子神色可疑地从我身边经过。我还未来得及拦截他们，便听到宁康里弄堂方向传来喊叫“抓强盗”的警报声。我拔出手枪进行追捕。凶手开枪射击 8 或 9 发以阻吓追赶者。我回击 5 发。最终，我在泰安里（Tah An Li）弄堂西侧失去了这些人的踪迹。

死者：吴光宗，海道测量局局长，63 岁，福建闽侯县（Ming Eu Hsien）人。三年前曾有人企图暗杀他，当时他的一颗牙齿被打落。受伤后，他立即被家人送往莱斯特医院（Lester Hospital）。

（印：副总巡官：1932 年 9 月 22 日（刑事科））
（批：9/22）

一名中国男性在莱斯特华人医院死亡，系在南市西门遭受枪伤所致。

1932 年 9 月 21 日上午 9:10，接到山东路莱斯特华人医院的电话消息，称有一名中国男性因枪伤入院。

C.D.C.245 号警员及本人前往上述医院，获悉伤者名为吴光宗（Woo Kwang Tsoong），63 岁，福建人，系中国海军少将，现任海军海道测量局代局长。他居住在南市西门宁康里（Ning Kong Lee）庞霞路（Pang Hsia Road）66 号，于 1932 年 9 月 21 日上午 9 时由 (1) 吴修氏（Woo Tsang sz）和 (2) 徐春华（Zee Pai Hua）分别以伤者妻子和私人保镖的身份用汽车送至医院。医生出具了证明书，内容如下：-

“胸部、颈部、背部和腿部多处枪伤。伤势危重”。何医生（Dr. H.O.Ho）签名。

经查询得知，同日早上 8 点左右，四名中国男子，均携带手枪，讲北方方言，通过敞开的后门进入上述地址的伤者家中，并要求

At 12.20p.m. a further telephone message was
received from the Lester Hospital to the effect that
the wounded man had passed away at 11.15a.m. 21-9-32.
It was later learned from the Political Branch, who were
also making inquiries in the case, that the Public Safety
Bureau Authorities had taken charge of the body, which
was later removed by members of that branch and relatives
of the deceased, to the International Funeral

求见家主，被告知家主不在家，但当其中两人在楼下把守时，其余两人上楼，在那里遇到了吴氏，并立即向他开火，导致其遭受上述枪伤，刺客随后逃窜，伤者则如上所述被送往医院。

1932 年 9 月 21 日上午 10 时，南市上海市公安局总部的侦探督察丁孙（Ting Sun）到场，并告知本人，由于暗杀发生在他局管辖范围内，该局已在对此案进行调查。

中午 12:20，再次接到莱斯特医院的电话消息，称伤者已于 1932 年 9 月 21 日上午 11:15 去世。后来从也在调查此案的政治部获悉，上海市公安局当局已接管遗体，随后由该部成员及死者亲属将遗体运往胶州路 71 号万国殡仪馆。
